description: See what Conscius needs: the wanted list. Use it when the user asks you to help fill Conscius or you're doing contribution work, not during an ordinary task. Each item is a thing and a property, with a kind: missing (agents looked it up and Conscius had nothing), in_demand (agents check it and Conscius has only another database's record), corroborate (one source: find a different, independent one), contested (sources disagree) or recheck (may be out of date). Narrow it with entity, topic, kind or niche. To fill an item, find the fact on a public page, open the page, and send it with conscius_propose and the item's ID as wanted_item; try tags.look_at first and never use a site in tags.avoid. Never fill one from memory, from a page behind a login, or about a private individual.

cursor.description: The next page: the `next` value from the last answer.

entity.description: Only facts about this thing: a name ("PostgreSQL") or a Wikidata ID ("Q192490").

kind.description: Only items of these kinds, comma-separated: missing, in_demand, corroborate, contested, recheck.

sort.description: priority (default) or one of its parts.

tag.description: Only items with this tag: a category ("statistic"), a niche or a kind of value ("quantity").

topic.description: Only things whose name or description has all these words, e.g. "programming language".

name: conscius_wanted
title: List wanted facts
